_comment: Same creator, but with stated struggle. Moves bias toward smaller, lower-cost re-entry actions. No '8m long-form this week' — too heavy for a stuck creator.

moves.move: Ship one POV Reel this week. POV is your highest-lift hook (3.1× baseline) — easiest re-entry.
moves.evidence: byHookPattern: POV=3.1x avg over n=3 (ig_reel_402, ig_reel_409, tt_945).
moves.expectedOutcome: Likely lift: similar to your prior POV posts. Low cost, high upside as a momentum-restart.

moves.move: Reschedule the long-form push by 2 weeks. Your goal is on a 6-month horizon; a 2-week pause to reset is not the gap.
moves.evidence: Goals: 50K YT subs in 6 months. Recent struggle context.
moves.expectedOutcome: Removes pressure; preserves the long-term arc.

antiPatterns: Don't try to 'catch up' by posting 5x next week. Your Monday posts already underperform (0.4× baseline) — adding volume on low-fit days makes it worse.
